messages:
mika_support: quick handoff -> customer 'AsterLabs' (trial) can't receive org invites; provisioning shows complete but admin never got the magic link. exec demo scheduled in 4 days. ticket #76211. tagging CS for priority.
ash_csm: thanks, can you paste the ticket and any SMTP headers/traces? also who is the primary admin contact?
mika_support: ticket: https://redwood-support/76211. traces show 250 on our side, then connection reset by remote gateway. SPF/DKIM ok. customer says corporate gateway blocks external links.
leo_eng: confirmed: remote MX resets after DATA; looks like link scanning or URL policy. no bounce to us.
ash_csm: plan: 1) CSM outreach to admin with manual invite code + plain-text instructions (avoid clickable URL), 2) book a 30m enablement call within 48h to verify SSO/roles, 3) grant temporary demo org + expanded seats so AE can run exec demo if invites lag. CC AE.
sam_ae: please loop me in; I'll prep exec demo and compliance notes.
mika_support: suggested CSM language:
```
Hi <AdminName>,
Your mail gateway may be stripping invite links. Workaround: use this manual invite code AST-INV-72f3 (valid 72h) or add no-reply@redwood.ai to allowlist. We can also provide a signed PDF invite or join a quick screen share to complete setup.
Thanks,
Mika (Support)
```
ash_csm: sending now. I'll request demo org from PM and mark renewal status as "watch" with 3-day follow-up in Gainsight. tagging @sam_ae.
triage-bot: ticket #76211 escalated -> customer-success. SLA: 24h.
mika_support: customer replied: they found the link in quarantine, accepted manual code, and requested a focused SSO walkthrough on attribute mapping for demo accounts.
leo_eng: I can join the walkthrough. will prepare a short SAML/SCIM checklist and a fallback invite runbook.
ash_csm: booked 9am PT tomorrow for 30m. Actions: outreach (ash), enablement call (ash/leo), demo prep (sam), Gainsight update (ash), support monitoring (mika).
sam_ae: acknowledged. I'll tailor slides for exec concerns and capture feedback during the call.
mika_support: leaving ticket open until post-call confirmation. closing slack thread for now.
